I'm talking both the original Frank Herbert stories, as well as those done by Brian Herbert and Kevin J. Anderson. For me, it has to be God Emperor of Dune. Every story in this universe is great, But Leto's stands out to me as the most epic, as well as the most tragic. The fact that he was bound by his destiny, though not completely trapped by his prescience like his father, was as bittersweet a situation as I can think of. To have to embrace his terrible purpose, or watch humanity fall... He never really had a choice. Humanity needed the Tyrant, even if they didn't want him.
So what is everyone's favorite book in the series, and why?

Hands down, everybody's favorite is God Emperor of Dune. It's the masterpiece of the series. You really can't ask which one is your favorite without excluding GEoD. Other than that, I'd say my favorite is a toss up between The Battle of Corrin, and Dune Messiah.
